Hi Elena —

Attached is invoice INV-4567 for September usage. Before AP kicks off payment can you confirm which rail Thermalia will use (EUR SEPA to our EU entity or USD wire to our US bank)?

Two quick asks so we can reconcile correctly:
- If you're paying by SEPA, please confirm the beneficiary name and IBAN exactly as your bank will see it (we can provide Redwood Inference Ltd details).
- If paying by USD wire, let us know whether you require a US vendor form (W-9) on file or any specific remittance fields.
- Also advise whether Thermalia will apply any VAT withholding or if this will be zero-rated/reverse-charge on your side — we can reissue the invoice with VAT breakdown if needed.

I've attached the PDF of INV-4567 and a quick bank-instruction stub for both rails. If easier, we can accept a one-time SEPA payment and follow up with reconciliation.

Thanks — a firm payment date will help us stop the collection cadence.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Thanks Naomi — adding a quick operational note from collections:

- If Thermalia needs to withhold VAT for local tax rules, we can accept a split payment (net remit now, VAT-witheld portion recorded) and then issue a credit/adjusting invoice once proof of withholding is provided. That keeps cashflow moving while we reconcile tax items.
- For SEPA we can accept full settlement and then handle bookkeeping on our side; just make sure PR/PO references are exact so the payment autos-matches.

Elena — if you do go SEPA, can AP confirm the expected value date? If it's next Thursday (10/14) we'll mark the invoice as pending payment and pause the collection cadence.

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Collections
Redwood Inference
